description: Hottest gas (~900 C) and strongest draft (~-200 Pa inlet): full-rate running
Draft ~0 Pa, gas ~620 C, material ~480 C: burner on before the fan starts, or a warm hold
Draft collapses to ~0 Pa, gas falls ~65 C per 30 min from ~800 C: ID fan has stopped
Normal temperatures but draft variability ~5x normal and weaker draft: process upset, fan/damper control hunting
Gas ~880 C, inlet draft ~-165 Pa, low variability: the bulk of running time
Outlet gas reads ~140 C below inlet while everything else is normal: outlet thermocouple drift, not a process state
